secrets.name: CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk publishable key (pk_test_...) from a Clerk DEVELOPMENT instance. The server throws 'Missing Clerk Secret Key' for every request without the pair, so the API cannot serve anything.

secrets.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk secret key (sk_test_...) from the same development instance as the publishable key.

secrets.name: VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: The same pk_test_... publishable key, exposed to the browser. Without it the app derives a key from the preview hostname, which no Clerk instance knows, so Clerk JS fails to load and sign-in never becomes available.

secrets.name: OWNER_EMAIL
secrets.description: Verified primary email of the owner's Clerk account; only this account receives the OWNER role. Also the only address authorized to start the Ω owner access flow. No owner access exists until it is set.

secrets.name: OWNER_USERNAME
secrets.description: Username of the registered owner account for the Ω owner access flow. Checked server-side together with the password; without it the flow reports that owner credentials are not configured.

secrets.name: OWNER_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password of the registered owner account for the Ω owner access flow. Never sent to or stored in the browser, and never logged. OWNER_PASSWORD_HASH (a scrypt hash) may be provided instead.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: Optional: SMTP server used to deliver owner verification codes (for example smtp.gmail.com with an app password). Without a mail provider, or RESEND_API_KEY, the app reports that no code was sent instead of pretending one was.

secrets.name: SMTP_PORT
secrets.description: Optional: SMTP port for verification code delivery (465 for implicit TLS, 587 for STARTTLS). Defaults to 587.

secrets.name: SMTP_USER
secrets.description: Optional: SMTP username (usually the sending mailbox address).

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Optional: SMTP password or provider-issued app password used only to deliver owner verification codes.

secrets.name: MAIL_FROM
secrets.description: Optional: sender shown on owner verification emails, for example 'YOUSIVAR-OMEGA <no-reply@yourdomain>'. Defaults to the SMTP user.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional alternative to SMTP for owner verification code delivery: a Resend API key from resend.com.
